## What's new

Threadnote 5.1.0-beta.3 keeps Context Briefs useful by default across CLI and Manager, preserving relevant handoffs, decisions, and code-graph context for the task at hand.

### Keep useful evidence in default briefs

- CLI and Manager Context Briefs now retain useful handoff and decision memories together with related code-graph context through default routing.
- Agents get a more coherent starting point for continuing work, with relevant graph anchors kept alongside the context they support.
